title: observability: token/KV cost & latency dashboards + tracing + alert tuning
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds token-level cost/latency and KV-cache metrics dashboards; updates alert thresholds to reduce noisy paging; backfills tracing spans for KV cache hits/misses.
description:
Motivation: We need better visibility into per-token cost/latency and KV-cache behavior to diagnose tail-latency and cost regressions. This PR adds Prometheus metrics, tracing spans, Grafana dashboards, and adjusted alert thresholds so on-call noise is reduced while still surfacing true regressions.

Summary of changes: 1) New Prometheus metrics exposed from the serving runtime: redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds (histogram), redwood_inference_token_cost_units_total (counter), redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_cache_lookup_latency_seconds (histogram). 2) Tracing: added spans around KV lookup/serialize and token-level emission with attributes (model, route, seq_len, kv_hit). 3) Grafana: new dashboard panels for token latency percentiles by model and route, token-level cost breakdown, KV hit-rate heatmaps, and a combined cost/latency per-token scatter. 4) Alert tuning: existing high-latency alerts were noisy; tuned thresholds to use p95/p99 token latency and added a composite alert that requires sustained p99 increase + drop in KV hit-rate before firing. 5) Backfill scripts: migration to populate metric metadata (Prometheus metadata) and dashboard JSON. 6) Tests: unit tests for metric naming/labels and an e2e smoke test for dashboard provisioning.

Commits (high-level): - Add token/KV metrics to runtime metrics registry and histogram buckets (aisha/metrics/token-kv) - Add tracing spans and attributes to runtime request path (aisha/tracing/token-kv) - Grafana dashboard JSON & provisioning (aisha/grafana/token-kv-dashboard) - Alert rules update & runbook adjustments (aisha/alerts/token-kv-tuning) - Add tests and fix linting/CI issues (aisha/tests/ci-fixes)

Files changed (high-level): ["serving/runtime/metrics.go", "serving/runtime/tracing.go", "observability/grafana/token_kv_dashboard.json", "ops/alerts/token_latency.rules.yaml", "ops/runbooks/token-kv-runbook.md", "tests/e2e/token_kv_dashboard_smoke_test.go", "pkg/metrics/README.md", "docs/observability/token_kv.md"]

Notes on implementation: - Histograms: added explicit buckets tuned for token-level latencies (0.1ms to 500ms) to capture both micro-batching and tail cases. - Cost units: emitted per-token as a small float counter; dashboards aggregate per-route/model. - Tracing: uses existing OpenTelemetry pipeline; added attributes to enable filtering by kv_hit=true/false to separate KV-local vs compute latency. - Dashboard provisioning: added as a Grafana provisioning JSON and included a migration to import in staging. - Alerts: new composite alert requires 10m sustained p99 increase > 30% and kv_hit_rate drop > 5 percentage points to open, with an immediate paging path for absolute p99 > 800ms regardless of KV. This reduces alert fatigue for small fluctuations.

Testing & CI: - Unit tests added for metric registration and label consistency. - e2e smoke test validates dashboard provisioning and checks that panels exist and have correct queries (runs in CI job grafana-provisioning-smoke). - CI initially failed due to linting and a flaky test; I fixed the linter issues and increased retry/backoff in the smoke test. All checks green on final run.

Review conversation (summary): - Miguel: requested clearer label semantics to avoid cardinality explosion; I limited labels to model, route, and quantization_profile (when present) and added a label whitelist in metrics.go. - Emma: asked to lower histogram bucket granularity for sub-ms and recommended explicit p99 calculation in alerts; implemented. - Jonah: requested a clearer runbook and an example query to debug cost vs latency; runbook expanded with step-by-step triage queries and sample Grafana links. - Several minor comments addressed: naming, logging levels, and test timeout adjustments.

CI checks: ["unit-tests: pass", "integration-tests: pass", "grafana-provisioning-smoke: pass", "lint: pass"]

Merge: Squash-merged after approvals from Miguel and Emma, and final CI green. Merged to main on 2026-02-18.

Follow-ups: - ENG-4381: instrument per-model quantization_profile more broadly (linked). - Add long-term retention of token histograms in metrics pipeline for 90d in a follow-up PR.
